title: Coordinate Plane Basics Assessment
description: Show that you can identify axes, origin, quadrants, ordered pairs, and plot or name points accurately.

questions.question: Which statement correctly describes the y-axis?
options: It is any point in Quadrant I.
questions.explanation: The y-axis is the vertical number line on the coordinate plane.

questions.question: Which point is 6 units left and 1 unit up from the origin?
questions.explanation: Left gives a negative x-coordinate and up gives a positive y-coordinate, so the point is (-6, 1).

questions.question: Which quadrant contains the point (-4, -8)?
questions.explanation: Both coordinates are negative, so the point has sign pattern (-, -), which is Quadrant III.

questions.question: The point (7, 0) is on the x-axis.
questions.explanation: A point is on the x-axis when its y-coordinate is 0.

questions.question: A point has sign pattern (-, +). Which location matches it?
questions.explanation: Negative x means left of the y-axis, and positive y means above the x-axis. That region is Quadrant II.

questions.question: Write the ordered pair for a point 5 units left and 3 units down from the origin.
questions.explanation: Left gives x = -5, and down gives y = -3. The ordered pair is (-5, -3).

questions.question: Which point is located on the y-axis?
questions.explanation: A point is on the y-axis when x = 0, so (0, 9) is on the y-axis.

questions.question: A plotted point is 4 units right of the origin and 2 units above the x-axis. Write its ordered pair.
questions.explanation: Right gives x = 4, and above the x-axis means y = 2. The ordered pair is (4, 2).

questions.question: Explain why (0, -3) is not in Quadrant IV.
questions.correctAnswer: The point (0, -3) has x-coordinate 0, so it lies on the y-axis. Points on an axis are not in any quadrant.
questions.explanation: Quadrant IV has positive x-values and negative y-values. Since x = 0, the point is on the y-axis instead.

questions.question: A learner plots (-2, 5) by moving 2 units right and 5 units up. Identify the mistake and give the correct movement.
questions.correctAnswer: The mistake is using the wrong direction for the x-coordinate. Since x = -2, the correct movement is 2 units left and 5 units up.
questions.explanation: A negative x-coordinate means left, not right. The y-coordinate 5 still means up.
